title: Speaking — The value of practice
description: Part 1 interview, a cue card and a Part 3 discussion on the value of practice.

questions: What part of your work or study do you look forward to?
When do you usually find it easiest to focus?
What would make your workplace or classroom more comfortable?
Do you expect to do something different in future?
Which activity have you improved at by practising regularly?
How do you choose what to practise next?

part2.topic: Describe a skill where small improvements made a big difference over time.
part2.closing: and explain why the improvement mattered to you.

questions: When is regular practice more useful than attending a course?
How can technology help learners notice improvements that are hard to measure?
What differences would you expect between a large city and a small town in relation to the value of practice?
